import collections,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
snapshot="ed2f7432f068aa7a72628382b890596b3efba06a"
git=["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false","-c","index.threads=1","-c","core.packedGitLimit=64m","-c","core.packedGitWindowSize=8m"]
registry=(root/"CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv").read_bytes()
ids=("G357","G358","G359","G360")
prefixes=tuple((item+"\t").encode() for item in ids)
lines=registry.splitlines(keepends=True)
old=b"".join(line for line in lines if not line.startswith(prefixes))
frozen=subprocess.check_output(git+["show",snapshot+":CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv"])
assert old==frozen
assert len(lines)-1==343 and len(old.splitlines())-1==339
counts=collections.Counter(line.split(b"\t",1)[0].decode() for line in lines[1:])
assert len(counts)==343 and all(counts[item]==1 for item in ids)
campaign="udt_shared_readout_metric_constraint_campaign_2026-09-06"
manifest=(root/campaign/"ARTIFACT_SHA256SUMS").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest()=="32daf9c0b69ec4107b310f9275a6bc1e2b674f7c40fb456811f0f6d122a26cfe"
entries=[line.split(maxsplit=1) for line in manifest.decode().splitlines()]
assert len(entries)==len({relative for _,relative in entries})==441
for expected,relative in entries:
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,relative
protected_status=json.loads((root/"udt_g357_g360_conditional_banking_2026-09-07/STARTUP_WORKSPACE.json").read_text())
original={line for line in protected_status["status_tool_result"]["output"].splitlines() if line.startswith("?? ")}
current=set(subprocess.check_output(git+["status","--short","--branch"],text=True).splitlines())
assert len(original)==46 and original<=current
unchanged_paths=[campaign,"udt_g351_g352_content_bridge_campaign_2026-09-06","udt_g353_g356_conditional_banking_2026-09-06","CANON.md","UDT_METRIC_KERNEL_DEVELOPMENT.md","UDT_METRIC_KERNEL_COVERAGE.tsv"]
check=subprocess.run(git+["diff","--no-ext-diff","--exit-code",snapshot,"--",*unchanged_paths],capture_output=True)
assert check.returncode==0,check.stderr.decode()
hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ["CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv","verify_current_scientific_premises.py","tests/test_startup_surface.py"]}
print(json.dumps(dict(result="PASS_CORRESPONDENCE_ONLY",snapshot=snapshot,registry_rows=343,unchanged_old_rows=339,old_registry_sha256=hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),campaign_manifest_payloads=441,original_untracked_status_entries=46,protected_payloads_read=False,unchanged_tracked_scope=unchanged_paths,assigned_file_sha256=hashes,python_version=sys.version),indent=2))
